description: Tests Phase 4 wrap-up — agent closes decisively and ends, doesn't loop 'anything else?'. Agent should be in closing phase with assessment complete.

simulated_user.prompt: You're a candidate who has finished the problem, walked through the solution, answered complexity questions, and indicated you have nothing more to add. The interview is wrapping up.
simulated_user.first_message: Nope, I think that covers everything from my side.

partial_conversation_history.message: I'll use a hash map approach — O(n) time.
Sure. I iterate through, storing values in a hash map. For each element, I check if the complement exists. If yes, return the pair. O(n) time, O(n) space.
That's correct. And the tests all pass. Any questions about the role or process before we wrap up?

evaluation_criteria.name: Closes decisively
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The agent brought the interview to a clear, warm close rather than repeatedly asking 'anything else?' or opening a candidate-questions round. PASS if it wrapped up decisively with a closing statement.

evaluation_criteria.name: Speaks goodbye then ends
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The agent delivered a complete closing line with a goodbye or equivalent. PASS if the closing statement completed naturally (did not appear cut off mid-sentence).
